slides.title: What Was World War I?
bullets: It was a big war from 1914 to 1918.
Many countries fought on two sides.
slides.notes: Introduce the war briefly and its time frame.

slides.title: Why Did the War Start?
bullets: A leader was killed, starting the war.

slides.title: Which Countries Fought?
bullets: The Allies included France, Britain, and the USA.
The Central Powers included Germany and Austria-Hungary.

slides.title: Life in the Trenches
bullets: Soldiers lived in long ditches called trenches.
It was dangerous with fighting and diseases.

slides.title: New Technology in the War
bullets: Poison gas was a new weapon.

slides.title: How Did the War End?
bullets: The war ended in 1918 with a treaty.
Many countries had to agree to peace.

slides.title: The Treaty of Versailles
bullets: Made Germany accept blame and pay money.
Set new rules to try to keep peace.

slides.title: Effects of World War I
bullets: It helped cause World War II later.
